items.program_name: 雇用創出税額控除(OH JCTC)
items.verbatim: Ohio Tax Credit Authority approved a Job Creation Tax Credit of 1.860% for 20 years on 2026-06-29 for a project in Williamsburg Township, Clermont County. Commitment: create 650 full-time equivalent employees generating $50,000,000 in new annual payroll at the project location.
